description: 市役所の窓口で、女性が職員に申請書を渡しており、近くでは男性が記入台で書類を書き、別の市民が番号札を持って順番を待っている場面。

stage1.passage: Many people visit city hall when they need official documents or public services. Residents may fill out application forms, wait for their number, and speak with staff members who help them complete important procedures correctly.

q1.text: What may residents do when they visit city hall?
modelAnswers: They may fill out application forms, wait for their number, and speak with staff members.
Residents may complete forms and talk with staff members to receive public services.

questions.text: Have you ever been to a city hall or public office? What did you do there?
modelAnswers: Yes, I have. I went to city hall with my family to get an official document.
I have been there to change my address and fill out some forms.
No, I have not been there by myself, but I have visited city hall with my parents.

questions.text: What public services do you think are important for people in a community?
modelAnswers: I think health care and garbage collection are important because everyone needs them.
Public information and support services are important because they help people when they have problems.
I think schools, hospitals, and safety services are especially important for a community.
